text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's amazing! Everyone's crazy strong!
I can't match their strength of heart!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even soooo...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I want to believe that if you keep working hard long enough, good things will happen!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: To me, to anyone, that's whyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Another miracle, an absolute miracle!
Whenever this girl runs, miracles happen!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle wins it!!
Chasing, chasing, endlessly pursuing, she has
finally taken the lead ahead of every single horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, yaaaay!
Everyone here in the audience, we did itttt!!
(UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer, we did itttt!
Over here, over here! Hurry up!
Called over, I jumped into the track and rushed over.
choice_data_list: Congratulations, that's the greatest miracle ever!
Congratulations, that was the ultimate miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~? I mean, I won too,
but this is a huge win for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Betting your life on an Umamusume like me... I thought you had zero eye for talent.
At first, that is~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, it looks like I was the one
who lacked an eye for talent~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: When you open it up, mine's pretty decent! No, actually, it's amazing! It's practically the grand prize, right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, okonomiyaki it is!
Tonight is totally, definitely okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let's eat everything from one end of the menu to the other! The Ultra Special Miracle MIX!!

Hishi Miracle is overjoyed.
Watching her—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What don't you understand, Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Her ability is—more than sufficient.
She has won many GⅠ races up to now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And yet—it's as if she won a GⅠ for the first time.
Why can she be so overjoyed?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that's just how it goes
between the best of companions!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To reel in a big catch, sometimes you need
a massive wave of excitement like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. So that's what led to the loss.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Restart.
Once more... towards my mission."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek... Giving a comment
in front of this huge crowd~?
That's so not my thing~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well, since we're already here, maybe just a little bit...

Hishi Miracle stood in the center of the winner's circle,
looking somewhat hesitant and timid—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehh, to everyone who put their dreams on me, congratulations~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I'm not in any position to preach, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even among today's members, there's just one thing I can boast about. And that is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That means only I am the Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Think about it! Other Umamusume
are girls who can put in the effort from ears to tail!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if I win, it ain't no miracle!
Not at all! But just makin' it this far
is already a miracle for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to respect about them at all.
You shouldn't, and I definitely don't either!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, wouldn't it be wonderful if an Umamusume
like that could win?
Wouldn't it give people hope?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: And the reason I was able to win was surely—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to someone who wished for me to win.
Even though I don't even know what they look like...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think the expectations of someone who was
so much like me... helped carry me to victory.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Looking good, Hishi Miracle—!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've known ya forever.
I love ya the most of all, man!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey... thanks. I'm glad
there's someone at the track who says so.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Believe it or not, I'm pretty popular in my class. Everyone tells me, "Having you around doesn't bother me at all."
(Ahahahaha!)

Warm laughter rings out from the crowd.
That, too, is—

It was all thanks to Hishi Miracle's charm,
which made her beloved by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That was... a fine speech.
Heroes are eccentric by nature, after all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I think only you could talk about it like that, Hishi Miracle-san."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Indeed. This distance between them...! Truly a model of fan service.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: An approachable charm we could never pull off... It gives me chills! It's so inspiring!
Both heroes joined in with warm applause—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So that's why, please try believing in miracles
just a little bit, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Even if I can't manage on my own,
I just have to trust someone who reaches out to me."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"If you meet someone precious and do all you possibly can,
I'm sure..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Miracles happen to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~!!
